items.question: How many Emiratis does the Nafis programme aim to employ in the private sector over the next five years?
items.gold: 75,000 Emiratis over the next five years.
items.fact: Nafis aims to employ 75,000 Emiratis in five years

items.question: How much monthly contribution must a non-compliant private sector company with 50 or more workers pay for each citizen not employed under the Emiratisation target?
items.gold: AED 6,000 monthly for every citizen not employed according to the required target (since 2023).
items.fact: Non-compliant firms with 50+ workers pay AED 6,000 monthly per citizen
